whatItFakes: Nobody opens the game knowing a schoolmate. The generated school acquaintances (social:generated-school-acquaintance) are deleted with their writer (engine map line 12), and schooling before the start is not simulated yet, so a player who has just turned 18 starts out knowing only family, household and, with a job, their workgroup. Schoolmates are read from the school engine's attended records once a school year is attended in play.
why: One history (owner, Oct 28): the generated past is deleted as each piece is simulated; the schooling pass before the start is engine map line 7 (wire-opening-and-home), and a classmate meeting needs that record.
replacement: The pre-start schooling pass (engine map line 7) records each person's school and school years in the school engine's attended records; sharedHistory reads schoolmates from them and the opening meets each student's class through the encounters engine.
